title: Professional Email Renewal Counted in a Hosting Prefund
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts, for the Professional Email subscription on the primary domain of the hosting plan a prefund deposit carries

## Which subscription

The email subscription the prefund counts is the one on the plan's primary domain, active with auto-renew on, when its next auto-renew attempt is today or no more than 14 calendar days after today. Its attempt days are the email charter's first renewal attempt day before the term end date, then 3 and 1 calendar days before its term end date, the email charter's retry days; the next attempt is the first of these that is today or later.

## How it is billed

Its renewal falls due on its term end date while it is active, so it is a term renewal under the Professional Email published term-renewal rule, billed for its renewed seats at the seat price of its billing plan, the product's annual-prepaid seat price per month times 12 for each seat on the annual prepaid plan and its monthly seat price on the monthly plan, and where the product's account discount applies its charge is reduced by the account tier's email discount, the discount being the charge less the reduced charge rounded half up to the cent, while Microsoft 365 seats are never discounted.

The email charge of the prefund follows the subscription's seat records:

| Subscription so counted | Email charge |
|---|---|
| a scheduled seat count is set | the lower of the scheduled seat count and the seat count, but never fewer than the mailboxes in use, times the seat price |
| no scheduled seat count, and idle seats | the mailboxes in use times the seat price |
| any other subscription so counted | the seat count times the seat price |
| not so counted | no email charge |

The mailboxes in use are the seat count less the idle seats, the mailbox deletions recorded on the subscription in the current term less the restores of those deletions, a deletion and its restore counting in the current term where the whole calendar months from the deletion date to today are no more than the whole calendar months from the term start date to today.

The charge so found enters the credit the prefund must cover.

## Hypothetical subscriptions

| Seats | Scheduled seat count | Deletions in the current term, not restored | Mailboxes in use | Seats billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 3 | 1 | 5 | 5 |
| 6 | 3 | 4 | 2 | 3 |
| 6 | none set | 1 | 5 | 5 |
| 6 | none set | none | 6 | 6 |

At an annual-prepaid seat price of $2.10 per month, 5 seats are counted at 5 times $2.10 times 12, $126.00, before any email discount. A deletion that was later restored leaves no idle seat; on a subscription whose term started six whole calendar months before today, a deletion three whole calendar months before today counts in the current term and one nine whole calendar months before today does not.
